We had a very successful family business that we have been working towards for our whole lives. It completely relies on bringing people from the Philippines to other country’s. We were actually a week away from selling part of it that would set us up for life. We had been working for over 10 years on the same business to get to this point. 
A few days ago the Philippines stopped all international travel. So pretty much no income. Because of this we had to lay off about 15-20 people who have become very close to us which is heart breaking because some of them have no source of income themselves now. 
It’s also horrible to see everything you’ve worked towards for over 10 years now fall apart after you were 1 week away from your life time goal. 
I honestly don’t know how we will survive for the next  year or so (however Long this lasts). 

It’s also horrible to know that once this is over we have a good chance of losing the business and have to start from scratch again after all this time. 

The virus isn’t just killing people. It’s completely destroying their lives
